The '''Tahv Constabulary''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. At the time of [[Hilts Restoration]] they were led by the [[Prefect of Police]], [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Takara Hilts]].

In [[2974 BBY]], [[Police officer/Legends|members]] of the Tahv Constabulary led by Prefect Takara Hilts apprehended [[Parlan Spinner]], an outlaw and anarchist who had attempted to assassinate [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]] during the celebrations commemorating the first landings of the Lost Tribe on Kesh during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].
